notes.title: Finalising Update
notes.notes:
Improvements

[list]
[*] Added a much better story spanning all levels including an intro and end.
[*] Balanced the game to include a much better difficulty curve.
[*] Improved bosses.
[*] Added a couple of new characters to talk to.
[*] Balanced weapons.
[/list]

If you would like to receive updates about Revenge Quest 2, go [url=https://www.fyngames.com/revengequest/subscribe.html]here [/url]and enter your email.

Feel free to send bugs and feedback to me at support@fyngames.com
